title: Workspace bindings are never tested despite owning persistence and fallback resolution
reasoning: This module owns nontrivial behavior: it parses and rewrites sessionStorage state, normalizes conversation refs and workspace bindings, and chooses a workspace binding from either conversation metadata or the first memory metadata. The feature metadata includes no linked tests, while the package has an available Jest test command. A regression in parse failure handling, malformed metadata normalization, or conversation-vs-memory precedence would silently change which workspace is associated with a conversation.
recommendation: Add focused Jest coverage for storage round trips, malformed storage payloads, empty conversation refs, clearing single/all bindings, and resolveConversationWorkspaceBinding precedence between conversation metadata and memory metadata.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no linked tests, and no test file excerpt is included for these exported helpers.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a workspace infrastructure test that mocks window.sessionStorage, imports the module in isolation per case, and verifies set/get/clear behavior plus resolveConversationWorkspaceBinding precedence and malformed input handling.
minimumFixScope: Add focused tests for conversationWorkspaceBinding.js exports without changing production behavior.
